title: Refactor Event Structure
description: Refactor the hook event log structure to use native/event/response layout. Replace raw field with native object containing event (native hook input) and response (native hook output). Resolve all file paths and queries to proper semio repo IDs in event data.

interactions.summary: Refactored HookLogEntry from {Raw, Event, Response} to {Native: {Event, Response}, Event, Response}. Added HookLogNative struct with Event and Response fields for client-specific data. Added resolveEventIDs, resolvePathToFileID, resolveRangeRef, looksLikeFilePath functions to resolve raw file paths into semio-repo ID system. Updated logHook to generate native response via EditorProvider.FormatHookOutput. Fixed mmss filename format. Updated all test references from entry.Raw to entry.Native.Event. All hook tests pass.
